final: WITH media_type_avgs AS (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT) / t.Milliseconds) as avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) as overall_avg FROM media_type_avgs) SELECT mta.Name, mta.avg_bytes_per_ms, (mta.avg_bytes_per_ms - oa.overall_avg) as above_overall FROM media_type_avgs mta, overall_avg oa WHERE mta.avg_bytes_per_ms > oa.overall_avg ORDER BY mta.Name
